adaptation.reference: This analysis fixes the seed, using NumPy PCG64, so a synthetic realization is reproducible; the published example leaves the seed unspecified.
adaptation.overlap: Half the segment length, following the module implementation and the cited manual's noverlap parameter.
adaptation.noise_band: The last half of the one-sided density, starting at segment_samples // 4, follows the cited example.

criteria.peak_frequency: Absolute error no larger than half the returned frequency spacing; this is a demonstration criterion for this isolated dominant tone.
criteria.reference: These are analysis-defined numerical demonstration criteria, not equipment operating limits or statistical confidence intervals.

readiness: Synthetic numerical example only; no measured engineering input or equipment acceptance is established.
retention: The generation recipe, seed, library versions, array digests, full plotted frequency and density arrays, and compact metrics are retained. Raw measured data are not used.
